HARMONY.Definition: peaceful agreement between people, without arguments

MILDLY.Definition: gently, making something sound less bad than it really is

MISHAP.Definition: an unlucky accident or mistake, usually not serious

FAVOURED.Definition: preferred; liked more than other things

UNDERSTATEMENT.Definition: describing things as less serious or extreme than they really are

DEEP-ROOTED.Definition: strongly held for a long time and hard to change

DISCOMFORT.Definition: a feeling of being uneasy or embarrassed

OUTGOING.Definition: friendly and confident with other people

SINS.Definition: acts that break religious or moral rules

BLASPHEMY.Definition: words or actions that show no respect for God or religion

EXCEPTIONS.Definition: cases that do not follow the general rule

ENDLESS.Definition: seeming to have no end; very long

SLANG.Definition: very informal (language) used in casual speech

INDIRECT.Definition: not saying something in a plain, open way

CONNOTATIONS.Definition: extra ideas or feelings that a word suggests

TABOO.Definition: not socially accepted to talk about

LACK.Definition: the state of not having enough

TOOL.Definition: an object used for doing work, such as a knife or an axe

SHORT OF.Definition: fewer than; not enough to make

PADDING.Definition: a soft layer that protects against something hard

TREADMILL.Definition: a process that keeps repeating without ever getting anywhere

SLURS.Definition: insulting words used to hurt or criticise people

LIBEL.Definition: printing false statements that damage someone's good name

DEFAMATION.Definition: harming someone's good name with false statements

SUED.Definition: made to face a legal case asking for money

EXTRA-MARITAL.Definition: outside of marriage, while married to someone else

RICH TAPESTRY.Definition: a large, varied and interesting mix
